metadata.scenario: A customer requests an appointment for a dental cleaning next month. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is William Chen. I hope you’re doing well! Hi William! I'm doing well, thank you. How about you? I’m good, just recovering from that knee surgery. I wanted to set up an appointment. Of course! What type of appointment are you looking to schedule? I need a dental cleaning for next month. I see. Just to clarify, we specialize in home healthcare services; dental appointments aren’t part of our offerings. Oh, I see! I thought you might handle that too. Unfortunately, we focus on skilled nursing and therapy. Would you like to schedule a follow-up for your physical therapy instead? Yes, actually. I’d like to continue with my physical therapy sessions. Great! When would you like to schedule your next session? How about next Tuesday at 10 AM? Let me check... Yes, Dr. Rodriguez is available then. Perfect! Let’s book that. Alright, I’ll set you up for physical therapy with Dr. Rodriguez next Tuesday at 10 AM. Thank you! And how long will the session be? The sessions usually last about 45-60 minutes. Great! I really appreciate the help. You’re very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I was also wondering about the medication management service. We do offer medication management; it’s priced between $65 and $80 for a session. That sounds interesting. I might need help with organizing my medications. Would you like to schedule that as well? Yes, let’s do that. Maybe right after my physical therapy? How about 11:15 AM next Tuesday? That works for me! I’ll book the medication management session for you at that time. Thank you so much, Margaret! My pleasure, William! You’re all set for next Tuesday at 10 AM for PT and 11:15 AM for medication management. Thanks again! Have a great day! You too, William! Take care!
